queries.sql: SELECT tb1.* , tb2.* , tb3.kata_name, tb4.wilaya_name , tb5.mkoa_name FROM bmc_patient_profile tb1 INNER JOIN bmc_patient_wallet tb2 ON tb2.pat_id = tb1.pat_id INNER JOIN bmc_mkoa_wilaya_kata tb3 ON tb1.loc_kata = tb3.kata_id INNER JOIN bmc_mkoa_wilaya tb4 ON tb4.wilaya_id = tb3.wilaya_id INNER JOIN bmc_mkoa tb5 ON tb5.mkoa_id = tb4.mkoa_id WHERE tb1.pat_id = '1' LIMIT 1
